description: Items 1-3 from prior session queue: derive m_W from substrate, apply formula to T(2,9)/T(3,5) strong-force, investigate W/Z anchor asymmetry. Honestly frames each as derivation OR negative finding.

item_1_mw_from_substrate.verdict: m_W cannot be derived from substrate alone without v. Conditional formula: m_W = (π·h_0)·v/2, with v as the open structural quantity.

item_2_strong_force_torus.verdict: T(2,9) trace gives non-zero ≈ 0.5 MeV from naive formula. Gauge-massless gluons require a SEPARATE categorical mechanism (gauge invariance projection). Cannot be derived from trace alone.

item_3_wz_asymmetry.verdict: The 1% W/Z asymmetry IS the gap between RT-chain prediction (P_2/P_3 ≈ 0.891) and SM cos θ_W (≈ 0.882). The trace formula captures the structural pattern but doesn't include the SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y mixing mechanism. Closing the 1% requires the SM electroweak symmetry breaking chain (Higgs VEV mixing g and g').

overall_verdict: All three items face the same structural barrier: the framework's RT trace chain on H_2(q) cannot fully derive SM electroweak masses without a categorical chain for v (Higgs VEV), g/g' mixing, and gauge-invariance projection (for massless gluons). The trace gives the SHAPE of the mass spectrum (within 1% on W/Z ratio) but the absolute scale and the W/Z 1% gap require SM-electroweak structure.
